messages:
sarah.ng: Heads-up — found a regression in the Console RBAC surface. Editor users are seeing admin-only dropdowns on project settings :eyes:
kevin: Repro'ed. Steps: login as editor, go to /org/123/project/abc/settings, admin menu visible. API calls return 403 for actual admin endpoints though. UI shows buttons incorrectly.
anar: I grabbed logs from the canary run. We're seeing permission check mismatch: server returns DENY but UI cache shows ALLOW. Looks like role alias table used by the client was stale after the role-split migration.
kevin: curl repro snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $EDITOR_TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/abc/settings \
  -d '{"billing":true}'
# response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_permissions","detail":"perm_check: DENY (requires: project.admin)"}
```
sarah.ng: Important: this isn't just cosmetic. Users saw the button and attempted actions; audit logs show denied attempts but the UI flow confused them. We need fix before wider rollout.
linda: Also discovered KMS decrypt warnings in the same timeframe: `kms.decrypt error: AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:...:alias/console-session` — might be unrelated but happening during the same deployment.
anar: My suspicion: the client-side role matrix was updated by the frontend deploy, but backend role mapping (service that resolves role aliases -> permission sets) deployed in a different order. Race introduced a window where UI assumed editor->editor_v2 mapping included admin_view=false but aliasing was inconsistent.
infra-bot: Deploy 1765432197 to service/role-resolver completed (sha:abc123).
opsec: We need an incident triage checklist: 1) stop further frontend rollout, 2) schedule a canary rollback for the client, 3) ensure audit logs retained for 90d, 4) see if any elevated actions succeeded (so far none). Approved?
kevin: Proposed immediate mitigation: hide admin-only controls behind server-side gate (server returns 'show_admin_controls': true|false) instead of relying on client cache. Quick patch in frontend + small server flag endpoint. I'll open PR.
linda: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/console/+/4321 — quick change to query `/api/v1/session/controls` on mount. Also added KMS error telemetry to the same endpoint so we can correlate.
sarah.ng: Plan: revert the latest frontend release for the public cohort (rollback canary), merge kevin's PR behind a feature flag, rollout to 2% for 30m, watch audit logs and KMS decrypt metrics. If no regressions, expand.
opsec: +1 for canary. Also request a replayable migration job to reconcile role alias mappings and generate an audit of all users with transient admin affordances during the window.
anar: I'll run policy-replay against production logs to find any user IDs that saw admin controls. Also will run `role-mapper backfill --from=2026-03-20T00:00Z --to=2026-03-21T00:00Z` and store output in s3://redwood-audit/rbac-backfill/1765432199.csv
kevin: Adding extra audit entries for denied attempts so we can track any automated retries.
sarah.ng: Thanks. Once kevin's PR is merged we should also add an alert: if UI indicates ALLOW but server returns DENY for the same request more than 5 times in 1 minute for a project, page eng-security on-call.
linda: I pushed hotfix branch and opened canary rollout: https://deploy.redwood.ai/canaries/1765432205 (frontend rollback + server flag)
kevin: Monitoring: watching `ui_allow_server_deny` metric and `kms.decrypt.failures`. Will post back in 15m.
sarah.ng: Good work team. Keep messages short and post any P0 findings here. If we see any successful admin actions, escalate immediately.
